run_train_model: run the python module train.py to train a multi-task model with a config file and serialization directory
create_tasks_and_vocab: create tasks and vocabulary from params for multi-task learning with datasets loaded per task
run_multi_task_training: run multi-task training with recover flag to resume a crashed training run from saved state
evaluate_model_on_test: evaluate the trained model on test data for each task using best epoch weights
save_metrics_to_json: save validation and test metrics to a JSON file in the serialization directory
